telemetry_events.description: DC Bus Voltage Ripple High (Exceeds 45V RMS threshold)
telemetry_events.diagnostic_note: Indicates degradation or open-circuit failure in one phase of the electrolytic DC bus capacitor bank or input diode rectifier bridge.

telemetry_events.description: Overcurrent Trip - Instantaneous Hardware Trip (IGBT Bridge Inverter)
telemetry_events.diagnostic_note: Peak current exceeded 250% nominal motor full load amps (FLA: 340A). Probable ground fault in motor stator windings, moisture condensation inside motor terminal conduit box, or shorted IGBT module in phase U.

recommended_troubleshooting_sequence: 1. Isolate 480V 3-phase line supply and wait 10 minutes for DC bus discharge LEDs to extinguish. Measure DC bus terminals (+/-) with multimeter to verify < 50V DC before touching.
2. Perform insulation resistance (Megger) test on motor leads disconnected from drive: 1000V DC test voltage; minimum acceptable resistance is 100 Megaohms to ground.
3. Perform multimeter diode test on VFD output terminals U2, V2, W2 relative to DC+ and DC- bus bars. Forward bias drop should be 0.35V - 0.55V. Reverse bias should read open-circuit (OL).
